description: Source file for font rendering and text handling in the Wesnoth game, including font management, text rendering, word wrapping, and floating labels.

classes.name: font::manager
classes.description: Manages font initialization, cleanup, and font list setting.

classes.name: font::text_surface
classes.description: Represents a rendered text surface with caching and measurement capabilities.

classes.name: font::text_cache
classes.description: Caches text_surface objects for reuse to optimize rendering.

classes.name: font::floating_label
classes.description: Represents a floating label with position, movement, and rendering logic.

classes.name: font::floating_label_context
classes.description: Manages a stack of label contexts for drawing and undrawing floating labels.

methods.name: font::set_font_list
methods.description: Sets the list of available fonts based on provided subset descriptors.

methods.name: font::load_font_config
methods.description: Loads font configuration from 'data/fonts.cfg' and initializes font list.

methods.name: font::add_floating_label
methods.description: Creates and adds a new floating label with specified properties.

methods.name: font::move_floating_label
methods.description: Moves an existing floating label by specified offsets.

methods.name: font::scroll_floating_labels
methods.description: Scrolls all floating labels by specified amounts.

methods.name: font::remove_floating_label
methods.description: Removes a floating label by its handle.

methods.name: font::show_floating_label
methods.description: Shows or hides a floating label.

methods.name: font::get_floating_label_text
methods.description: Retrieves the text of a floating label.

methods.name: font::get_floating_label_rect
methods.description: Gets the rectangle bounds of a floating label.
